summary: Sealed reserve car park in bush by the river; no homes mapped.
reasons: Bush behind, river park in front

drivers.seclusion: Forest to the south, picnic lawn and river to the north; no buildings other than park shelters.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park on an unclassified road, with room for a van beside the parked vehicles.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end reserve road; very little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Boat trailers and cars parked; park users, no campers seen.

flags: Low-lying: about 2 m elevation near the Pine River, tidal flooding possible
Reserve may close the car park at night
Picnic and boat-ramp users by day
sun_shade: Mixed: trees shade the strip from the south and east; open to the north.

best_section.where: Sealed car park strip at the pin, south of the picnic lawn and above the river
